title: InsightRAG: Aggregating Distributed Scholarly Judgments for Scientific Survey Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.28085v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The rapid growth of scientific literature makes survey writing increasingly challenging, motivating automatic survey generation. Yet, existing systems must search an open space of papers and an open space of concepts with no trace of how the community itself has navigated them, leading to incomplete scope, weak taxonomies, and unreliable citations. Our core insight is that author-written Related Work sections contain the human judgments needed to address both limitations: authors curate the citations relevant to their contributions and explain how the cited works relate, yielding paths for scope reconstruction and relational evidence for organization. We propose InsightRAG. Its insight-guided retrieval follows author-supported citation relations to reconstruct a verified research scope and structure the resulting relational evidence. translated_title: InsightRAG：聚合分布式学术判断以实现科学综述自动生成
translated_abstract: 科学文献的快速增长使得综述写作变得越来越具有挑战性，这推动了自动综述生成技术的发展。然而，现有系统必须在开放的论文空间和开放的概念空间中进行搜索，却完全没有学术共同体自身探索这些空间的痕迹，导致综述范围不完整、分类体系薄弱以及引用不可靠。我们的核心洞察是：作者撰写的相关工作章节包含了解决上述两个局限所需的人工判断——作者会精心挑选与其贡献相关的引用文献，并解释被引文献之间的关系，从而为研究范围重构提供了路径，也为组织结构提供了关系证据。我们提出了 InsightRAG：其洞察引导的检索沿着有作者支持的引用关系来重构经过验证的研究范围，并对由此得到的关系证据加以结构化；随后在最小冲突目标下聚合这些判断，形成一个反映反复出现的……（原文在此截断）的分类体系。
tldr: InsightRAG从作者撰写的工作章节中挖掘人工判断，沿作者支持的引用关系重构经过验证的研究范围，并以最小冲突目标将这些判断聚合为分类体系，从而生成范围更完整、结构更可靠的科学综述。
en_tdlr: InsightRAG mines human judgments from author-written Related Work sections, reconstructs a verified research scope via insight-guided retrieval along citation relations, and aggregates these judgments under a minimum-conflict objective into a taxonomy for reliable scientific survey generation.
